issues.issue: Citations reference domain-level URLs only, lacking specificity to actual studies or pages
issues.fix: Where possible, link to specific articles, studies, or pages (e.g., a specific NCBI PubMed study URL) rather than homepage domains to improve credibility and verifiability

issues.issue: The 2021 analysis referenced in-text is not explicitly matched to a specific source entry — it is vaguely attributed to footnote 4 (Journal of Cannabis Research) without a direct study title or author
issues.fix: Add a study title, author name, or publication year to footnote 4 so the specific claim is traceable and verifiable by readers and AI crawlers

issues.issue: NORML (footnote 5) is an advocacy organization and may reduce perceived academic neutrality when cited alongside peer-reviewed journals for botanical classification claims
issues.fix: Consider replacing or supplementing NORML with a peer-reviewed botanical or taxonomic source (e.g., a specific Cannabis taxonomy study on PubMed or a university extension publication) to strengthen scientific credibility

issues.issue: The article states the entourage effect is 'the most accurate predictor of effects' in the Key Takeaways, which is a slightly overstated claim — the entourage effect is well-supported but still an area of active research with some scientific debate
issues.fix: Soften the language to 'one of the most important factors shaping your experience' or add a brief qualifier acknowledging ongoing research to maintain scientific precision

issues.issue: THC range for hybrids listed as 15–28% in the comparison table, which is accurate but may underrepresent modern high-potency hybrids that commonly exceed 28–30% in dispensary products
issues.fix: Update the THC range for hybrids to 15–30%+ or add a note that some modern hybrids significantly exceed these averages to reflect current dispensary reality

issues.issue: The 'How to Actually Choose a Strain' section uses bullet-point questions but does not provide a concrete decision-making framework or example walkthrough
issues.fix: Add a short worked example (e.g., 'If you want evening relaxation: look for myrcene >0.5%, THC 18–22%, CBD >0.5% — something like Northern Lights or a similar indica-dominant hybrid') to make the guidance more immediately actionable

issues.issue: No H3 subheadings are used beneath H2 sections, which limits topical depth signaling for search engines and reduces content hierarchy granularity
issues.fix: Add H3 subheadings within longer sections (e.g., under 'How Terpenes and Cannabinoids Shape Your Experience,' add H3s like '### Key Terpenes to Know' and '### Minor Cannabinoids Worth Asking About') to improve crawlability and featured snippet eligibility

issues.issue: Meta description is 160 characters — at the absolute upper boundary; some rendering environments may truncate it
issues.fix: Trim the meta description to 150–155 characters to ensure it displays fully across all search engine result page layouts without truncation risk

issues.issue: The image alt text is descriptive but does not include the target keyword in a natural, conversational way — it reads slightly as keyword-stuffed
issues.fix: Revise alt text to: 'Visual comparison of indica, sativa, and hybrid cannabis plant types and their key differences' for a more natural, accessibility-friendly phrasing while retaining topical relevance
